summary: Gildan Activewear filed a 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 news release (quarter ended September 27, 2026) and announced that its board approved a new normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 5% of issued and outstanding common shares, the Canadian equivalent of a US open-market buyback authorization. The release also disclosed completion of the HanesBrands Australia divestiture on October 26, 2026, Q3 net sales of $1.47 billion, adjusted diluted EPS of $1.54, and updated FY2026 guidance of $5.4-5.5 billion revenue, ~20% adjusted operating margin, $3.70-3.80 adjusted EPS and $700-750 million free cash flow. Prior 2026-2028 objectives were withdrawn amid weaker demand, with a long-term outlook deferred to a spring 2027 Investor Day. Watch buyback execution pace and demand commentary.
